english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for someone or something that is exceptionally good.
Use this as the all-purpose choice when someone or their work is notably good, especially for skills or achievements.
This is the all-purpose choice when something is exceptionally good or of superior quality.
For a remarkable or excellent quality, this is the all-purpose everyday choice.
Use this when extraordinary means remarkably good or impressive in quality or performance.
Use this when praising unusually strong work, performance, or ability.
Choose this when highlighting outstanding quality, ability, or performance in a more measured way.
Use this when the person, ability, or achievement is outstanding rather than merely unusual.
